ModMetaData.name: VCEPU Waste Fix
ModMetaData.author: XHszDHM
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes the "Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute" exception thrown by Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded - Unofficial Expansion (bambaryla.VCEPU).
That mod's CompWasteProducer_ProduceWaste_Patch.Postfix drops wastepacks while iterating the ThingOwner they live in, so every mech gestator that finishes with wastepacks inside throws an InvalidOperationException and the remaining wastepacks stay stuck.
This mod removes the broken postfix at startup and installs a corrected one that snapshots the matching items first. Only affects the buggy patch; no gameplay changes.
